# dsh-tada
Native desktop notifications for DeepSeek Harness, installed as a regular DSH plugin.
**English** | Chinese
When an Agent finishes a turn, fails, needs your approval, or asks a question, dsh-tada alerts you i
n the least intrusive way:
| Where you are | What you get |

| Reading the conversation that just finished | Nothing — it is already on screen |
| In DSH, readin

g another conversation | In-app toast |
| In another app | System notification |
Notifications are raised by DeepSeek Harness itself, so the OS notification center shows DSH's name
and icon, and clicking a notification opens the exact Session. The plugin patches nothing in DSH and
has no runtime dependencies. It works in the Desktop app and in `dsh web`.
Every alert is driven by a DSH event the plugin observes; no notification depends on the model decid
riven by a DSH event the plugin observes; no notification depends on the model deciding to ping you.

in** and enter `dsh-tada`.

## Configure
Open **Settings → Notifications**. Changes apply as soon as you click **Save** — no reload, no resta
n **Settings → Notifications**. Changes apply as soon as you click **Save** — no reload, no restart.

- **Notification content** — edit the title and body templates with a live preview.
- **In-app toast

** — auto-dismiss after 1–30 s, or stay until you click **Open** or **Dismiss**.
- **Notification be

havior** — master switch and per-event switches.
- **Advanced** — delivery channels, app name, notif
ication language, quiet hours, minimum interval, and body length.
### Default events
| Event | Default |

| Turn complete, errors, approval needed, question asked | On |
| Subagent, workflow, or goal finish

plete, errors, approval needed, question asked | On |
| Subagent, workflow, or goal finished | Off |
### Templates
Titles and bodies can mix text with these presets:
| Preset | Value |

| `{{app}}` | App name (default `DSH`) |
| `{{event}}` | Localized event label, for example `Turn co

mplete` |
| `{{session}}` | Session title |
| `{{workspace}}` | Workspace title |
| `{{detail}}` | R
eply preview, error message, question, or tool reason |
The defaults are title `{{event}}` and body `{{session}}`. Unknown placeholders stay visible so typo
tle `{{event}}` and body `{{session}}`. Unknown placeholders stay visible so typos are easy to spot.
### Quiet hours and throttling
- Quiet hours use `HH:MM-HH:MM` and may span midnight. They silence automatic turn-end alerts; appro

vals, questions, and subagent/workflow/goal alerts are always delivered.
- The minimum interval (def

ault 1500 ms) limits how often turn-end alerts fire per Session.
- Notification copy follows the app
language by default; it can be forced to English or Chinese.
## Troubleshooting
- **No system notifications?** The Desktop app normally grants the permission automatically. In a br

owser (`dsh web`), allow notifications when the page asks.
- **Alerts missing after an upgrade?** Re

load the DSH page so the new Client half registers; restart DSH after a Host-side update.
- **Need d
iagnostics?** The loopback-only status endpoint reports the channel state and contains no secrets:

`client/client.js` — edit the source, not the bundle.
